label: lab, Playwright
method: Chromium 390x844 mobile emulation, 4x CPU throttle, Slow-4G (150ms RTT, 1.6/0.75 Mbps), cold cache. Interleaved A/B (qa/perf-ab.template.js): original main (1b23d25) and the shipped code (3567792) both served locally with `next start`, alternating load by load with the order swapped each round, 5 rounds per page, medians reported. 'photo' = first on-screen photo that is decoded and not faded out (rAF poll). TBT = sum of (longtask - 50ms) during load + 5s.
why_interleaved: Machine timing drifted during the session: the same unchanged Stage 6 build measured LCP ~2.2s earlier and 2.0-4.5s later. Separate before/after runs taken hours apart are not comparable; interleaving cancels the drift.

browse.note: Original LCP undercounts: its grid fades in from opacity 0 after hydration and Chrome does not report those photos as LCP. First visible photo is the honest comparison (8.7s -> 3.8s; every after run beat every before run).

live_production_after.note: Taken while the machine was in its slow phase (local control of the same build: FCP 2.0-4.5s). HTML arrives by ~0.4s and CSS by ~1.5s, so the gap to first paint is main-thread time on this throttled machine, not Vercel. Not comparable with qa/perf-before.json (live, taken hours earlier in the fast phase).
